Bahamut BOSS BATTLE Time to take on an aeon! Remember to Steal a Mute Shock off him before the battle ends. Bahamut cycles through one fixed attack pattern: “Curse” or an ordinary physical hit (Curse locks a girl into her current dressphere) Ordinary physical hit Ordinary physical hit “Impulse” (takes 37.5% of HP) “Impulse” again “Countdown” “Mega Flare” Then the cycle starts over. The first Impulse tells you Countdown is near, and Mega Flare hurts badly, so have everyone fully healed before it comes. Impulse cannot kill: it takes a percentage of HP, like Demi. With a pattern this simple there is little more to say. If you are struggling, grind some EXP by the Save Sphere to level up your Dark Knights. dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Creepy hole, creepy ladder, creepy hallway.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Um. That's a lot of creepy.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: It's Bevelle.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Ormi
dboxTimeline.text: Boss, it's — it's big in here.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: It's empty, you lump. That's worse.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: That's not machina.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: That's an aeon.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Bahamut.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: It's me. You know it's me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Please. You have to stop.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: It's not in there, Yuna.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Fight. You don't get another option.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: It stopped. That's not mercy.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: That's a timer.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Is it — Yunie, is it slowing down?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: No. It's counting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: It's almost over.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: You can rest. You can rest.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: ...Yunie.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I'm fine. Let's find the machine.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Did it do that? Did it dig its own way out?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: That size doesn't leave in a hurry.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Not unless something called it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: This isn't how it was supposed to be.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: Well. Obviously it heard I was coming.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Leblanc
dboxTimeline.text: Logos. Ormi. Record all of it. Every hole.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Logos
dboxTimeline.text: ...Recording the hole. Naturally.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: The Calm. I can feel it coming apart.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: Everyone back to the ship. Now

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: No arguing! This is a Brother order!
